notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3i-base..HEAD as usual. SEGMENT e3i: E3-8's first four groups: blocks face the way they are placed, outlines of walls, panes and bars, players and mobs on pressure plates, and dispenser clicks, smoke, golems and withers.

groups.prompt: Track E3 group placed-facing: build track-e3.md section E3-8 group placed-facing. Commits, in order: (1) 'Minecraft pistons, observers, dispensers, droppers, repeaters, comparators, crafters and calibrated sculk sensors face the way they are placed', (2) 'Minecraft barrels, pumpkins, workstations, glazed terracotta and anvils face the way they are placed', (3) 'Minecraft rods, amethyst, chains and pillar blocks point along the face they are placed on'. Key points: new arms in third_party/minecraftoss/player/src/placement.rs block_entity_placement after the lectern arm, using nearest(yaw,pitch)[0] (= getNearestLookingDirection), horizontal(yaw), opposite, clockwise and view.face. Pistons, dispensers, droppers and barrels: nearest, opposite. Observer: nearest. Comparator and repeater: horizontal, opposite; the repeater's locked is true when a side neighbour (clockwise or counter-clockwise of its facing) is a powered repeater or comparator whose facing equals the direction to it. Calibrated sculk sensor: horizontal with no opposite, plus waterlogged. Crafter: orientation <front>_<top> with front = nearest.opposite and top = horizontal.opposite for down, horizontal for up, else up; triggered=false (decision: crafters are inert and the player World has no signal). Commit 2: carved_pumpkin, jack_o_lantern, loom, stonecutter, beehive, bee_nest, chiseled_bookshelf, vault and *_glazed_terracotta face horizontal.opposite; the three anvils horizontal.clockwise. Commit 3: end_rod takes the clicked face, but the opposite when the block behind is an end rod facing the clicked face; *lightning_rod, amethyst_cluster and the three buds take the clicked face plus waterlogged; extend the _log/_wood axis rule in lib.rs:2104 to the crimson and warped stems and hyphae (stripped too), hay_block, bone_block, basalt, polished_basalt, quartz_pillar, purpur_pillar, deepslate, infested_deepslate, bamboo_block, stripped_bamboo_block, muddy_mangrove_roots, the froglights, iron_chain and the copper chains (chains waterlogged). Not creaking_heart (M3's). Do not touch M1's World trait lines 98-238 in lib.rs. Tests: in placement::tests with the view/state helpers, plus a lib.rs test for pillars. No wire change. Write the owner's steps F-1..F-8 and F-MP and the kit line from the brief into docs/round10/track-e3-log.md.

Key points for commit 1: in third_party/minecraftoss/world/src/level/mod.rs add pub bodies: Vec<entity::LevelBody> right after living_players (:188), with an empty init. LevelBody { source: game_event::EventSource, min, max } lives in entity.rs. Add a new bodies_on_plates beside entity_inside (:1294) that visits the blocks under each body's box shrunk by 1e-5 and calls plate_check_pressed(pos, state, 0, Some(source)) when plate_signal==0, called with one line at the end of tick_entities (:602). plate_signal_strength (:1345) also counts the bodies meeting touch (all living, so stone plates count them). In crates/minecraft_terrain/src/server.rs run_tick, the line after :5084 fills sim.level.bodies from the alive, non-spectator input.mob_players (0.6 x 1.8 box, EventSource::Player(id)) and from sim.mobs.mob_ids() with body_of (EventSource::Mob(id)). Bodies are last tick's mob positions (decision). The scheduled release (redstone.rs:833) then sees them as well. Commit 2: crates/minecraft_terrain/src/doors.rs release_sound (:453) also answers *_pressure_plate power or powered going from 0 to above 0 (click_on) and back (click_off), volume 1, pitch 1. Sets: stone and polished_blackstone give stone; light and heavy weighted give metal; otherwise wood_set (:291) (wooden, cherry_wood, bamboo_wood, nether_wood). The callers in render_anim already play it. Tests: gated server tests with door_world/place, and a doors.rs unit test, as the brief lists. Do not touch the test-only player/src/redstone.rs:238 path. Track E3 group dispenser-blocks: build track-e3.md section E3-8 group dispenser-blocks. Commits: (1) 'Minecraft dispensers and droppers click, fail and puff smoke like vanilla', (2) 'Minecraft dispensers put carved pumpkins on golem bodies', (3) 'Minecraft dispensers place wither skulls and build withers'. Key points for commit 1: in world/src/level/dispenser.rs add DISPENSE_EVENT 1000, FAIL_EVENT 1001, SMOKE_EVENT 2000 and BONE_MEAL_EVENT 1505 next to ROCKET_SHOOT_SOUND. The empty branch (:78-84) pushes 1001 for both dispenser and dropper, with no smoke. The dropper's no-container path pushes 1000 plus smoke; a dropper into a container plays nothing. Add let count = stack.count before the match, and one call dispense_effects(pos, &name, count, &result) before container_set_item (:130), so no arm line M1 or M2 anchor on changes (their arms sit after water_bucket at :110 and after honeycomb at :112). Effects: firework_rocket gets smoke only; optional names (bone_meal, honeycomb, carved_pumpkin, wither_skeleton_skull, glass_bottle, glowstone, shears, flint_and_steel) get 1000 when the stack shrank or changed, else 1001; the rest get 1000; then (2000, pos, facing.index()). The bone meal arm pushes (1505, target, 15) on growth. In crates/minecraft_terrain/src/level_events.rs add constants taken from the world crate and arms right after LAVA_FIZZ: 1000 block.dispenser.dispense 1.0/1.0; 1001 block.dispenser.fail 1.0/1.2; 2000 shoot_smoke as LevelEventHandler.shootParticles (10 times: r=nextDouble*0.2+0.01; pos+0.5+step*0.6+step*0.01 plus (nextDouble-0.5)*0.5 jitter times stepZ on x, stepY on y and stepX on z; motion step*r+nextGaussian*0.01), with Kind::Smoke. Commit 2: golem_build.rs gets SNOW_GOLEM_BASE [" ","#","#"] and IRON_GOLEM_BASE ["~ ~","###","~#~"] after GOLEMS, and can_spawn_golem beside find. Do not edit M3's :191-199; if M3's copper golem build has merged, add its base as one line, otherwise log it. Add a dispenser arm carved_pumpkin after the bone meal arm: air in front and can_spawn_golem lead to set_block_and_update(carved_pumpkin), block_game_event_from("minecraft:block_place", target, None, None), shrink; else unchanged. Leave the OTHER_BEHAVIOURS lines alone (the earlier arm wins). Commit 3: wither_build.rs gets BASE_ROWS ["   ","###","~#~"]; matches_at takes the rows; add find_base; wither_cell becomes pub(super). The dispenser arm wither_skeleton_skull needs air, target.y >= min_y+2, difficulty != 0 and find_base; it sets the skull with rotation (south 0, west 4, north 8, east 12, vertical 0), posts the block_place game event, calls wither_skull_placed(target), and shrinks. No equipment fallback (left). Tests: gated server tests with replace_block_item, as the brief lists, plus pure tests in level_events, golem_build and wither_build.
